title: Principal Fellows & Admin. Intern. Stipends
aiSummary: This bill modifies North Carolina's Principal Fellows Program, which provides forgivable scholarships to help prepare school leaders, and adds a new stipend for administrative interns. The bill appropriates $5 million to expand the program and creates financial support for people in administrative internship programs.
aiProArguments: Supporters argue this bill addresses a shortage of qualified school leaders by making it more affordable to pursue principal preparation programs through forgivable loans and stipends. The expanded funding aims to increase the percentage of NC principals trained through this evidence-based program, potentially improving school leadership and student achievement, particularly in high-need schools.
aiConArguments: Opponents may question whether $5 million in new state spending is the best use of education funds, whether loan forgiveness effectively incentivizes service in high-need schools, and whether stipends for interns (funded from already-stretched school budgets) are sustainable long-term without additional revenue.
